s: a green-painted kiosk built into a former public toilet by the Eisbach
w: A kiosk by the Eisbach surf wave in the Englischer Garten, opened in 2011 inside a disused public toilet block -- more than 50 tons of old fittings were dug out to make room. "Frauen" still shows above the counter as a nod to its past life; the name plays on the building's fresh coat of green ("grün") paint. Organic regional snacks, cake and drinks for surfers and park-goers alike.
_facts: Located at Lerchenfeldstraße 1a, 80538 München, Englischer Garten, near the Eisbach surf wave
Opened in 2011 inside a former public toilet building
Over 50 tons of material removed from the old toilet block during conversion
Focuses on regional organic snacks, cakes and drinks

n: Ooh Baby I Like It Raw
s: a cosy Glockenbach hideaway leaning into raw and gluten-free brunch
w: A small, cosy café on Rumfordstraße in the Glockenbachviertel, its name a wink at the raw-food and gluten-free leanings of its brunch menu. Tucked among the neighbourhood's small independent shops, it runs on an intimate, unhurried scale rather than volume.
_facts: Known for gluten-free and raw-food-friendly brunch and café menu

s: a heavily photographed Maxvorstadt breakfast café built on detail
w: A Maxvorstadt breakfast café on Türkenstraße built around getting the small things right -- plating, props, light -- to the point of becoming one of Munich's most photographed cafés. The food backs up the looks: a full breakfast and brunch menu served through the day.
_facts: Known for breakfast and brunch, and a heavily styled, photogenic interior
Part of a small Mary's Coffee Club chain with other Munich locations

s: an all-day Schwabing hangout known for its club sandwich
w: An all-day café on a quiet Schwabing side street, running on solid standards -- a well-regarded club sandwich, piadine, bowls and salads -- rather than a rotating gimmick. The kind of steady neighbourhood spot locals default to without needing to think about it.
_facts: Known for its club sandwich and piadine
Open weekdays and Saturday mornings, closed Sundays
